verdict.rationale: Claude Code reads personal instructions and settings from ~/.claude, and these apply across all projects. In the chat app, memory carries context into new conversations, and users can review and edit what is saved. No evidence documents an explicit custom-instructions or response-preferences setting in the consumer chat app that shapes every response. Missing for 10: a documented account-level custom instructions/preferences setting in Claude chat, evidence that preferences apply to every response, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can set persistent custom instructions and preferences that shape every response

citations.quote: files in ~/.claude are personal configuration that applies across all your projects.
